scope: synthetic offline Phase 0L development-only prior-identity and probe-representativeness diagnosis on fresh seeds 121-140; static paired margins plus frozen Phase 0K guard-only rollout, no full-stream online optimization and no downstream LLM accuracy

spent_held_out_postmortem.allowed_use: labeled post-hoc diagnosis only; never calibration, exclusion, or renewed held-out evidence

advancement_gate.artifact_integrity: All 80 seed-by-prior-identity diagnostic runs must complete with config hashes, stream fingerprints, immutable run files, and deterministic aggregate fingerprint.
advancement_gate.contextual_identity_support: Contextual-oracle must improve mean static phase-0 stream margin over global-oracle by at least 0.08 and have positive phase-0 stream margin on at least 18/20 development seeds.
advancement_gate.probe_coverage_support: For global-adversarial, all phase-0 probes must agree in sign with the phase-0 main stream on at least 19/20 seeds and must not be less representative than the frozen guard stopping prefix.
advancement_gate.guard_safety_observation: Report, but do not tune on, contextual-oracle false resets and global/contextual-adversarial false-safe decisions under the frozen Phase 0K guard.
advancement_gate.promotion_limit: Passing this diagnostic gate only selects a Phase 0M development direction; no revised guard is promoted without a later disjoint held-out reliability phase.
